“Acceptable rates of virovic suppression were achieved using rural clinic and community-based resources in a program run by clinical staff and supported by lay treatment supporters.”

“A health centre/community-based ART program in rural Uganda, run by clinical officers with support from lay volunteers and treatment partners, achieved equivalent virologic suppression to a hospital-based program run primarily by physicians.”

the development and evaluation of an ART delivery model for rural Uganda, and provides evidence that the HC/community-based approach is an effective and feasible strategy for ART delivery in rural Africa.
